goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: RE-LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09). Budget-search correction: the iter-19 v27 lock (10M chars / bs384) FAILED to converge (2.2631 BPC, w7to9wg0) because cutting limit_chars 30M->10M + batch 96->384 slashed optimizer steps ~12x (43.7k->3.7k). The minimum budget that converges = 30M chars / bs96 / 40 epochs (~1.8483 BPC in ~28 min). These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept. sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.
